            print(f"    spec.data_path: {spec.get('data_path', 'N/A')}")
            print(f"    spec.model_name: {spec.get('model_name', 'N/A')}")
            print(f"    spec.seed: {spec.get('seed', 'N/A')}")
            print(f"    spec.checkpoint_path: {spec.get('checkpoint_path', 'N/A')}")
        print(f"    gpu: {e.get('gpu', 'N/A')}")
        print(f"    pid: {e.get('pid', 'N/A')}")

        print(f"  exp_id: {e.get('exp_id')}, status: {e.get('status')}")

                    val = spec.get(key, "N/A")
            print(f"    {key}: {val}")
